Chapter 1264: Chapter 19: The World of 10 Billion Particles (Subscription Requested)_2

Now Lin Yuan has three major true bodies of his original self, which are located in the Chaos Void, the First Source World, and the Second Source World.

But in terms of strength, the strongest true body is the one in the Second Source World, and this supremacy is indisputable.

Even taking into account the advantages of the universe within the Chaos Void and the advantages of the Fierce Sun Divine Body in the First Source World, they are far inferior to the true body in the current Source World.

“I am different from the Abyss Dragon.”

“The particle worlds opened by the Abyss Dragon are just ordinary particle worlds.”

“While the particle worlds I have opened are each reconstructed through the ‘Infinite Void’ legacy.”

Lin Yuan was spirited; the Thirteenth Order legacy of the ‘Infinite Void’ is a heritage directed at worlds, any world can be cultivated, and particle worlds are also worlds.

It is precisely because of this that even with the enhancement of merely ten billion particle worlds, it’s nearly comparable to the complete Constant Sand Particle World of the Abyss Dragon.

“As of now, the development of particle worlds is all normal, but it’s still best to wait for a complete practice to conclude.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that now his true body in the Third Source World is a pioneer, exploring whether there might be any danger in developing particle worlds.

If everything goes smoothly, once this true body has completely developed the Constant Sand Particle World, that would be when the other two true bodies begin their cultivation.

The reason the true body in the Third Source World is currently the strongest is because the other two have not yet commenced the development of particle worlds.

…

“Although the external demons claim to be endless, in the last millennium, as a result of my hunts, the number of ‘demons’ has noticeably decreased.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

A single Demon Spirit can provide Lin Yuan with resources to develop several hundreds to a thousand particle worlds.

A single Great Demon can provide the resources and energy for Lin Yuan to develop hundreds of thousands to millions of particle worlds.

And so far, Lin Yuan has developed ten billion particle worlds, giving an idea of how many Demon Spirits and Great Demons he has hunted.

While demons do not die, should their bodies be utterly obliterated, even upon recovery, it requires an immense amount of time.

“It seems I need to expand my hunting range to slay more Great Demons,” Lin Yuan thought to himself, as he continued developing particle worlds, becoming acutely aware of the vast amount of resources required.

…

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in a certain Desolate Void, where strands of breath intertwined in front of him, continuously forming runes, each resembling a manifestation of the great principles of the heavens and earth.

“This Rune Dao is truly effective.”

“Effortlessly replicating numerous rules and great principles lowers the threshold for cultivation significantly.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, feeling the intangible rules of the great principles and comparing it to sensing tangible rules, naturally, the difficulty is different.

“Before the dramatic change in the Third Source World, the number of strong individuals must have been incredibly high.” Lin Yuan, though unaware of the glorious scene pre-changes, deduced from the uses of the Rune Dao that it was undoubtedly a resplendent era of cultivation.

It is estimated that even those who achieved the Third Realm, comparable to the Invincible Great Saints of the Chaos Void, appeared frequently.

Keep in mind that even in the Second Source World, with the six major Ancestors of the six Great Ancient Countries aiding, those who could truly equal the strongest Venerable among the Invincible Great Saints were few.

“Sadly, the Rune legacies currently mastered by the Qingyun Saint Sect have been almost fully comprehended by me. To gain insight into more profound Rune legacies, I need to seek out more powerful sect influences.”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat helpless.

More powerful sect influences? The sect influences that have endured under the rampant ‘demons’ are all exceedingly secretive, finding their bases would be as hard as ascending to heaven.

Lin Yuan knows the whereabouts of several eternal sect forces at the center of the world, but the risk of going is still too great. If possible, Lin Yuan plans to complete the Constant Sand Particle World development before proceeding.

“Take it slow, if it comes to it, I may as well comprehend the subsequent parts of the Rune Dao.”

Lin Yuan thought, given a portion of the Rune Dao legacy, with his against-heaven’s understanding, he could attempt to create the subsequent parts.

But it would take an immense amount of time, and it’s uncertain if it would match the original Rune Dao. At least for now, Lin Yuan is quite certain that the development and perfection of the Rune Dao have undoubtedly gone through numerous Thirteenth Order time beings.

This simplification of the great principles is only achievable by Thirteenth Order time beings who look high from above.

Thirteenth Order time beings? Lin Yuan did not think his understanding was lower than that of time beings, but their perspective is different, as is the scene they see. The Rune Dao created by them is held in high regard by Lin Yuan.

“Let’s continue.”

Lin Yuan glanced around the Desolate Void. Centuries ago, he left the Galaxy Chaos Continent and traversed the Chaos Void, attempting to comprehend the operation of the entire Chaos Void.

Of course, on the Galaxy Chaos Continent, he left an avatar, capable of descending at any time.

And with Lin Yuan’s current renown in the Chaos Void, being the fastest in history to be certified with the title of Invincible Great Saint, this alone ensures the safety of the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

No Great Saint dares to cause trouble on the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

…

Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

Inside the highest main hall.

The Sect Master and various elders gathered.

“In the past thousand years, the number of ‘demons’ nearby has clearly improved.” An elder remarked with a puzzled expression.

Those younger disciples might not notice, but high-level elders, having experienced several Great Demon mountain assaults and cleared many places where Demonic Qi gathered nearby, occasionally encounter some Demon Spirits.

The threat of Demon Spirits is far less than that of Great Demons, and upon encountering Demon Spirits, the elders are not worried, given the sensing ability of Demon Spirits, they probably haven’t even discovered the existence of Qingyun Sacred Mountain.

However weak Demon Spirits might be, they are still ‘demons’, and shouldn’t just vanish inexplicably.

What’s particularly odd is that too many ‘demons’ have disappeared without reason, to the point many elders found it unbelievable.

“Isn’t the reduction in the number of demons a good thing?”

A few elders expressed some confusion, the fewer ‘demons’ around Qingyun Sacred Mountain, the safer the Sacred Mountain would be, wouldn’t it?

“You can’t think like that.”

At this moment, the Sect Master of the Qingyun Saint Sect spoke, his tone deep: “Most ‘demons’ reside permanently in a certain area. If the number of ‘demons’ in an area decreases, two possibilities exist.”

“First is the appearance of a more powerful ‘demon’ in the area, causing other ‘demons’ to instinctively retreat.”

“This would lead to a scene where the number of ‘demons’ decreases.”

The Qingyun Saint Sect’s Sect Master paused for a moment before continuing: “The second possibility is that the ‘demons’ in this area have been devoured, hence the reduction.”

With these words.

All the elders’ expressions subtly changed.

The ‘demons’ have been devoured?

Those capable of devouring ‘demons’ are most likely demon-entrants.

And demon-entrants, as they grow stronger, increasingly resemble actual ‘demons’.

A powerful demon-entrant is in fact not much different from most ‘demons’, perhaps retaining fragmented memories but emotions are mostly eradicated, to the extent that as they continue to grow stronger, even their memories dissipate quickly.

“A demon-entrant? Has there been another demon-entrant in our Holy Sect?”

An elder asked with a look of horror. Even they have noticed the reduction in ‘demons’ in the area, so it’s imaginable how many demons this demon-entrant has devoured.

Having devoured so many ‘demons’, even if the demon-entrant hasn’t touched the field of the Third Realm of freedom, it probably wouldn’t be far off.

Compared to external ‘demons’, demon-entrants are even more terrifying, as they hide within the Sacred Mountain, and you never know when they might strike.

“Not necessarily, it might be the first possibility, or perhaps it’s something beyond our consideration.”

The Qingyun Saint Sect’s Sect Master said.

In reality, none of the possibilities were favorable.

With a reduced number of ‘demons’ in this area and the loss of a considerable number of ‘demons’ expelling Demonic Qi, the concentration of Demonic Qi in the vicinity will gradually increase, drawing attention from further, more powerful ‘demons’.
